title: Spicy Malaysian Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy stew originating from Malaysia, made with a variety of ingredients and served with a side of steamed cabbage. This dish is perfect for a cool evening.

ingredients.name: stew
ingredients.notes: you can use beef or vegetable stew depending on your preference

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the elegant and cook until it's lightly browned.
Add the stew and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and let it simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the cabbage and cook until it's tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with steamed cabbage on the side.
